node.statement: Apply lem-maincb-reset-invariant-preservation to this eligible raw call and then lem-maincb-reset-output-typing: the resulting v_{U_1} has unchanged source M_1 and target A_{U_1}, is an extended W.c0_cb*epsilon_{U_1}-isomorphism because u_0 is bijective, and satisfies d_{U_1} <= W.c0_cb*epsilon_{U_1} and ||v_{U_1}(I_{M_1})-u_{A_{U_1}}|| <= W.c0_cb*epsilon_{U_1}. These fields and the isomorphism tag form the required def-maincb-reset-state datum.
